title: Is Coinbase's Steadier Side Really A Cushion?
summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) wants to be judged as more than a crypto trading venue. Its evidence is subscription and services revenue, the non-trading line the CEO says makes the business a bit more predictable. That line is the metric that should worry a holder. In the first quarter of 2026 it fell 16% quarter-over-quarter, and the stock is down about 39% over the past year even after a summer rebound.

title: Should You Buy Coinbase Stock While Its Revenue Is Shrinking?
summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) stock has gained about 18% over the past month, and it is still down about 44% over the past year. At about $175 a share, the market pays 7.3 times sales against 3.2 for the S&P 500, more than double the market's price for revenue that is shrinking. The question is whether what Coinbase is building is worth more than what it is losing.
